runtime.model: native default; record actual model from init

cases.name: explicit
criteria: native catalogue includes product-sense:product-sense from inline plugin
explicit native invocation loads plugin entrypoint

cases.name: implicit
criteria: native catalogue includes product-sense:product-sense from inline plugin
model selects skill without name in task
assessment preserves supplied evidence and scope, gives bounded next action and stop/reshape condition
final is at most 180 whitespace-delimited words

stopping_rule: One attempt per case. Stop a case on failure, authentication or permission block, cost cap or timeout; retain evidence and do not retry the model. No source edits during evaluation.
limits: No control arm or repeat samples
CLI host only; no claude.ai, Cowork or OpenAI plugin acceptance claim
Restricted settings differ from ordinary user sessions; record actual catalogue and tool events
Managed policy or runtime defaults may still apply; flags alone do not establish full isolation
